summary: KT Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing its 2026 Corporate Value-Up Plan, approved by the board on August 11, 2026. The plan targets a consolidated ROE of 9–10% by 2028 and includes KRW 750 billion (~$560 million) in treasury share buybacks and cancellations from 2026 through 2028, plus monetization of non-core assets (KRW 12.3 trillion book value) and strategic investments. This is a capital return program akin to a buyback authorization, not a tender offer. Watch for execution pace and any accelerations in buybacks, which could support share price.
